description: Pull quote: an oversized accent quotation mark swings in, the quote resolves word by word out of a soft blur, highlighted words get an accent underline sweep, then the attribution slides in behind a growing rule. Transparent background (optional scrim).

params.quote: The quote text (auto-fit, up to ~4 lines)
params.author: Who said it (optional)
params.role: Author's role/source, shown after the name (optional)
params.highlight: Comma-separated words to emphasise with the accent underline (optional)
params.font: Quote font family, default 'Playfair Display' (attribution uses Inter)
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output, default #0B0B10

defaults.quote: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
defaults.author: Alan Kay
